title: pick imagedata
explanation:
### Description

Test picking on image data using vtkImageSliceMapper.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → selection → output**

- [vtkCellPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellPicker.html) — cell picker.
- [vtkImageCanvasSource2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCanvasSource2D.html) — image canvas source2d.
- [vtkImageCheckerboard](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCheckerboard.html) — image checkerboard.
- [vtkImageSlice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSlice.html) — image slice.
- [vtkImageSliceMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSliceMapper.html) — image slice mapper.
- [vtkImageWrapPad](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageWrapPad.html) — image wrap pad.
- [vtkPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPicker.html) — picker.
- [vtkPointPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointPicker.html) — point picker.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
